messages:
tess: Quick heads-up: scheduling a quiet-window maintenance for bridge-fabric + GPU pool handoff in us-west1 (rack uw1-bridge-04) on 2026-11-03 02:00 -> 03:30 UTC. Goal: fabric resync (BGP hold-down), NIC microcode, and transient powercap tuning to avoid thermal oscillation. We'll do a conservative flow: fabric canary -> single-node canary -> 1-at-a-time node drains. ops-oncall please ack.

omar: ack. Why the fabric resync first? any risk of cross-rack flaps?

tess: Recent asymmetric paths caused transient packet reordering during heavy KV seed. Doing fabric resync first lets us stabilize topology so node rejoin doesn't trigger route churn. We'll hold BGP timers longer during the window.

vikram: Canary plan: fabric-canary is a controlled resync on top-of-rack switch tor-uw1-04, then node canary gpu-uw1-04-11. If fabric canary shows >0.5% error increase we abort and rollback BGP timers.

net-bot: Fabric maintenance scheduled: 2026-11-03T02:00:00Z -> 2026-11-03T03:30:00Z (ID: mw-2145000000-fabric). Auto-notify to netops and infra teams.

ops-oncall: I'm on channel. If any node rejoin causes >2% packet loss or p95 jumps >25% baseline we stop. Also watch BGP flap counters and route convergence time.

tess: Capacity note: expect ~18% transient drop in burstable GPU capacity during node handoffs. Because of fabric resync we may see slightly higher queueing; plan is to enable smart-fallback routing to us-west1-burst for traffic above queue-depth 65%. This uses reserved buffer instances (not preemptible) to keep latency stable but increases cost.

omar: Cost estimate for using reserved buffer for 1.5h is ~6.2k USD. finance-bot please prep contingency approval.

finance-bot: Contingency note created for mw-2145000000 estimated cost $6200. Notifying finance.

vikram: Run checklist (copy to runbook):
```
# fabric canary
netctl bgp-set-timers --peer tor-uw1-04 --keepalive 60 --hold 180 --dry-run
netctl resync --switch tor-uw1-04 --verify-links
# observe 10m for link errors/ECN rise
# node canary
kubectl cordon gpu-uw1-04-11
kubectl drain gpu-uw1-04-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
apply-nic-fw --node gpu-uw1-04-11 --ver 2.2.0 --verify-checksum
powercap-tune --node gpu-uw1-04-11 --mode thermal-stable --limit 230W
reboot-node gpu-uw1-04-11 --wait 300
run-health-checks --node gpu-uw1-04-11 --checks net/tx,pcie,gpu-temp,driver-logs
kubectl uncordon gpu-uw1-04-11
# if canary passes -> proceed 1-at-a-time with 10m soak and KV preseed after uncordon
```

vikram: KV warm commands after each uncordon:
```
uw1-cache-seed --pool uw1-gpu-pool --prefix "/embeddings/high" --parallel 4
uw1-cache-seed --pool uw1-gpu-pool --prefix "/chat/active_sessions" --parallel 2
```

tess: Additional workloads change: we'll temporarily reduce default batch size for hosted-generate routes on restored nodes to 0.8x for 10m to limit cold-cache bursts. Also enable verbose driver logs for 15m after uncordon and collect `dmesg`, `ip -s link`, `nvidia-smi -q` to s3://redwood-ops/maint/uw1/2145000000/.

ops-oncall: I'll add expvar metrics for packet-drop and route-convergence and an alert if rejoin >8m or >0.5% packet loss sustained for 3m. I'll also watch GPU eviction rate and temp >82C.

omar: One operational ask: annotate nodes with firmware/powercap after each successful run: `kubectl annotate node gpu-uw1-04-11 redwood/nic=2.2.0 redwood/powercap=230W`. That makes fleet queries simpler.

vikram: Communication plan: status banner T-40m, status page + slack T-20m, email to top-10 tenants T-15m. Console message: "uw1-gpu-pool maintenance (fabric & NIC)".

net-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m pre-notify at 2026-11-03T01:30:00Z.

ops-oncall: If we detect cross-region latency increase during fabric canary we pause and rollback BGP timers. We won't proceed to node drains until fabric is stable for 12m.

tess: Post-maint checklist: snapshot p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, queue-depth, packet loss, and upload run logs. If anything >thresholds we'll open a quick incident and capture blameless postmortem.

vikram: Thanks team. I'll post the runbook link here shortly and pin this thread for the window. :white_check_mark:
